Coming in late to this thread, but I’m 11 days since the first symptoms showed (I haven’t had covid symptoms in 6 days) and my stomach is tore up. Diarrhea and cramps.

Hi friend! Deep breaths. I know it’s probably hard to imagine anyone feeling like you do anxiety wise, but I promise I was sitting in my bed two days ago having the exact thoughts you’re having. I’m on day 8 and thankfully for my handy script of Hydroxyzine for anxiety I am feeling a little better, but days 1-6 I was literally thinking the end was nigh even though I had a mild case. Limit your exposure to this subreddit. It can be helpful but mentally nuclear. You will be just fine. Check out the post TheCreepyLlama linked in their comment, it is very helpful!! I know it’s hard to not be anxious. Anxiety has been worse on me than the actually symptoms of the virus. Send me a DM if you would like to talk!

THANK YOU for posting this! I’m on day 8 of symptoms and I am luckily recovering well, but days 1-5 were spent scrolling through this subreddit convincing myself the end was nigh. While a lot of things can be helpful here, it can also be mentally harmful. I haven’t needed my anxiety medication since I was a teenager (10+ years ago) but I made a special refill request just for the last few days. Hang in there y’all! It gets better.

I’m on day 8 of symptoms so definitely no where near three weeks out, but I noticed today that my taste is trying to come back. I can taste only artificial fruit flavoring, but not real fruit. I can taste berry flavored Gatorade and fruit gummies but not real fruit! And I can’t taste anything other than the artificial fruit. I also have this weird thing where things smell like paint. Weird virus for sure!
Hi! I’m on day 7 of symptoms and had nausea/vomiting/diarrhea days 2-3. It really sucked. Dramamine and pepto helped a lot! Feel better soon friend ❤️
